project.name: Card Table
project.summary: A live, prompt-defined card table where people and browser agents play the same two-seat games through direct controls or WebMCP tools.
project.ai_usage: Browser agents read seat-projected table state and a human-written game brief, then act through bounded WebMCP tools while the server enforces privacy and authority.
project.codex_usage: Codex helped plan, implement, test, deploy, and play the app; live two-thread smoke tests drove fixes to seat identity, zones, presence, contextual controls, and card motion.
